title: Implement book-aware preparation and mixed-record reconciliation
result: Fresh dtf-operator preparation, manifest, execution, and intent v2 formats; manual-book ABI hashing and row-specific pricing directives.
Stable NFT origin independent of book, all twelve loader book scalars, and the required separate NFT 3 contribution path.
Immutable saved-manifest rehydration and independent reconstruction of original configure and issuance execution/preparation/journal domains.
Canonical receipt/log ordering and transaction-prefix state for historical A completion after B, including intra-block overwritten book proof through the exact setter and subsequent canonical loader.
Current B configuration verified separately from immutable A issuance, its funded creation, preserved terms, current claims/retirement, and solvency.
Full original-input, component-credit and Q/C verification; claimed-SY pricing-set evidence and deployment-start configured-origin census.
set-pricing and confirm-book CLI routing, operation-sensitive preflight, unchanged donation-specific operation IDs, and authenticated empty-census owner-bond/activation without preparation.
One active execution per operator root, durable signed intents, nonce/gas/domain/plan checks, explicit completion, and terminal unsigned blocking without trapping the root.

cases: forged historical domainHash with surrounding hashes recomputed
same-block receipt/log order and full preimages
v1 execution and combined NFT 3 mode
rejections.beforeSigning: Execution preflight precedes nonce allocation and wallet creation; transport tests assert no submission and the book/quote cases assert no nonce request.

The dependent witness identity assertion remains red: the freshly built Solar runtime differs from its unchanged fixed hash. No pin was changed and no failing assertion was skipped or weakened.

decisions.chosen: Keep replaceable configuration and immutable issuance facts separate, authenticate each original domain and transaction, and resolve all persisted intents before checking a new load against current pricing.
decisions.rejected: Regenerating old credits at current prices, treating block-end B state as historical A, adopting an unknown replacement, migrating v1 journals, merging loader batches, or changing a source pin to make QA green.
decisions.terminalPolicy: Only an unsigned blocked attempt releases its active reservation; signed uncertainty must reconcile before another execution can proceed.

assumptions: The task 7 and operator reconciliation sections of the named plan are the specification; tasks 1-6 are preserved.

The existing wire fixtures test the real TypeScript operator boundary, while the hermetic script tests real deployed contracts. Neither is presented as a public deployment or a full real-RPC portable lifecycle run.
limits: No public transaction, installation, commit, delegation, source-index write, operator/recovery documentation edit, or pricing Solidity edit was performed.
Full real-RPC lifecycle and portable scenario runs assigned to tasks 10-12 were not executed.
Native LSP requests sometimes timed out and the JSON Biome server is absent; the full strict TypeScript checker passed, and no installation or suppression was used.
cleanup: All task-owned commands exited. Wire fixtures closed servers and removed owned temporary directories. No Anvil or compiler was killed for silence; no task-owned long-running service remains.
